## Abstract

This GeoEpi project brings together studies incorporating foot-and-mouth disease genomics, within-host dynamics, or animal experiment results. Registered work includes an agent-based disease transmission model, sequence mapping, incubation-phase transmission, and FMDV co-infection and recombination.

<article class="geoepi-subproject-card">
<h3>challengeABM an Agent-Based Disease Transmission Model</h3>

Agent Based Model (ABM) simulating within-host virus dynamics, room-to-room animal experiments, within-herd host transmission, and between-farm spread.

Incubation phase transmission of foot-and-mouth disease virus in cattle: experimental evidence and simulated impacts.

Foot-and-mouth disease virus variability and recombination on dairy farms in Pakistan.

<article class="geoepi-subproject-card">
<h3>Mapping Virus Diversity and Variation</h3>

Sequence-map converts aligned viral sequences and sampling geographic coordinates into PCA, DAPC, and other location-level summaries and optional spatial predictions of ordination-axis scores across geographic space.
